summary: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones S.A. (NYSE: IRS; BYMA: IRSA) disclosed a September 8, 2026 Preliminary Merger Agreement to absorb two wholly owned subsidiaries, Tienda Los Gallegos S.A. and Los Gallegos Martinez Navarro y Cia S.A., consolidating their real estate and shopping mall operations under one legal structure. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or timeline was stated; completion hinges on corporate and Argentine regulatory approvals (CNV/BYMA disclosure). The transaction is internal and non-arm's-length, so no public shareholders are cashed out. Watch for approval timing, dissent/impugnation risk, and any asset or debt reallocation.
